bad_calibration.primitive_test: direct Legendre of 2*alpha*b modulo the first failing small prime, compared to kernel hilbert(x0,d0,p)
bad_calibration.selection: first 20 bad rows by increasing k in each of (79,[5,1]), (83,[-5,1]), (7,[-3,1]); 60 total

d0_small_prime_residues.note: Per-row d0_support retains all kernel-factored support primes; residue tables intentionally tabulate odd support m<=1e6, while mod 4/8 tables cover the 2-adic part.

parity.interpretation: At the cofactor level, every prime-rung row has E={p}; after the replayed small strip has only +1 symbols, frozen and infinite +1 plus Hilbert reciprocity force (x0,d0)_p=+1. This is parity forcing. The residue tables are evidence only and do not add a congruence theorem.
